regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the true article title and the generic Pd/Brønsted-acid dehydrative coupling claim. The graphical abstract repeats the method concept and is not a separate experiment.
The Horner–Mark route is cited prior work and is classified as a literature example, not a current-paper experiment.
The transition-metal coupling of propargylic derivatives is a generic cited prior-work class; the listed leaving groups are retained without inventing a single execution.
Five distinct cited Lewis-acid condition sets were retained as literature examples with their printed catalyst loadings and temperatures; missing times/yields remain missing.
The present work's 36-example/up-to-95% method summary is a general scheme, not one experiment and not a substitute for Scheme 2 rows.

unresolved: All Scheme 1 structures contain generic R/Ar groups.
Prior-work comparison entries omit scale, time, solvent and/or yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper half Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–16, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Sixteen independent optimization runs were retained with shared 1a/2a charges, catalyst/loadings, DPEphos, acid, solvent volume, N2, 16 h, row temperature/solvent, NMR yield, recovery, and footnote overrides. Numeric zero yields are preserved.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 entry 15 and surrounding prose
regions.finding: The blank Pd cell and prose support a no-Pd control, while superscript d points to 'without DPEphos'. The conflict is retained rather than corrected; >99% recovery remains a qualified quantity.

The prose identifies the Scheme 2 families, low-reactivity 3pa/3ae cases, 3Aa X-ray assignment, and 3af/3wf cyclic-phosphonate products. These statements were linked to the 36 separate page-3 scope records.

unresolved: Entry 15's Pd/DPEphos omission is internally inconsistent between table, footnote, and prose.
Scheme 2 yield basis is not stated.

regions.region: page 3 left upper and center Scheme 2, all 36 labeled products and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Thirty-six independent substrate-scope examples were transcribed with substrate/reagent labels, shared conditions, superscript overrides, row reaction time and yield. The 3pa, 3ac and 3ae substrate recoveries are separately targeted to the starting material.
Three independent experiments were retained: 4.0 mmol/27 h gram-scale 3aa synthesis (1.4515 g, 94%), PhSeCl selenohydroxylation to (E)-5 (85%), and CuBr2 bromohydroxylation to (E)-6 (81%).

Two kinetic series were retained using the exact printed regression equations, R2 values, tested loadings and textual first-order conclusions. Graph pixels were not over-read into invented tabulated rates.
The text introduces Scheme 5 as a possible catalytic cycle; it is classified as mechanism and linked to the page-4 drawing.

unresolved: Scope/derivatization yield bases, workups, purifications and masses are not reported except the gram-scale 3aa mass.
Kinetic fixed conditions and tabulated rate values are absent.
Many compact structures remain label-only or machine-unverified.

regions.finding: The proposed protonation, anti-oxidative addition, ligand exchange and reductive elimination sequence was recorded as a mechanism; intermediates I–III are not isolated experiments.
